signal_evidence.consumer_stress_tier: Q1 GMV was $101 billion, that is up 35%... new buyer orders are occurring at nearly twice the rate of other channels — no trade-down or essentials-pressure language; demand signals are broad-based across merchant sizes and geographies.
signal_evidence.services_demand: Shop App GMV was up 70% year-over-year... monthly active users grew over 40% year-over-year and unique buyers purchasing directly on Shop grew over 50%.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We will always lean into growth... we are making every function faster, sharper and more productive... investment in AI infrastructure, global reach and platform depth.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: We see a clear path for the [payments penetration] rate to continue moving higher... variable platform fee average rate has increased — pricing power present but constrained by competitive dynamics in SMB tier.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: We delivered the highest quarterly revenue growth rate in over 4 years, both for the business as a whole as well as the U.S. specifically... this is Shopify operating at its best.
